d: Very long, flowing pale ice-blue hair with straight bangs and a white veil. Sharp, glowing crimson eyes with a focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender, fit build wearing a revealing black and gold bodysuit with asymmetrical white and brown stockings and gold high-heeled shoes. Large white feathered wings and a floating golden ring halo above the head, while holding a long purple and gold staff.
